line: Heartwood is an invented 2016 small-group DVD course (Leader's Edition); every lesson in it is taken from real ministries' booklets and courses, 1987–2016, and the 1993 Exodus floppy-disc analogy is read word for word.

facts.text: PAHO (the WHO's Regional Office for the Americas), May 2012: in none of its manifestations does homosexuality constitute a disorder or an illness, "and therefore it requires no cure"; such therapies "lack medical justification".
facts.source: "'Cures' for an illness that does not exist", position statement, p. 1; news release 17 May 2012

facts.text: Exodus International announced on 19 June 2013, at its 38th annual conference, that it was shutting down; its president apologised for promoting sexual orientation change efforts and reparative theories.
facts.source: Religion News Service in The Christian Century (24 July 2013 issue)

facts.text: Royal College of Psychiatrists, April 2014: "There is no sound scientific evidence that sexual orientation can be changed."
